sentences.text: This is the finished oak bowl, oiled and ready for the table.
It started as a rough blank from a fallen tree.
Here is the raw oak blank, still wet and heavy.
The grain tells me where the bowl wants to be.
On the lathe the shape appears in long, steady cuts.
I keep the wall thickness even from rim to base.
Sanding goes from coarse to fine, with the lathe turning slowly.
This is where the grain starts to glow.
A coat of food safe oil brings out the color.
24 hours later, the bowl is ready to use.
